symbolDescription: Image attributes as stored on an image node.

optionDescriptions.src: The source, sanitized before it reaches the document.
optionDescriptions.alt: Alternative text; an empty string marks the image as decorative and is kept.
optionDescriptions.title: The image's advisory title.
optionDescriptions.align: How the image sits in the flow.
optionDescriptions.caption: The caption, which serializes as a `<figure>` with a `<figcaption>`.
